newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Rubber prices rise at Colombo auction for 3rd week.
newsitem.headline: Rubber prices rise at Colombo auction for 3rd week.

text.p: Rubber prices rose for the third week in a row at Thursday's Colombo auction where 374 tonnes were on offer, brokers said.

Best latex crepe one-x rose 25 cents to 73.75 per kilo from Tuesday, when the auction was last held. Number one was unchanged at 72.25 and RSS1, which went unquoted on Tuesday, was at 65.25 per kilo, brokers Forbes & Walker said.
Overall prices were about one rupee higher, they said.
"The steady upward movement is due to an end-of-summer lethargy and unusual rains in rubber growing areas," said one. --Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
